shapeDescription: homogeneous sphere: Lorenz-Mie (Mishchenko spher.f) hat-function averages on the GRASP v1.1.3 41-node grid with full end nodes (GEOSmie_TOA graspkernels); replaces the KERNELS_BASE sphere kernel (its 13 deg column was interpolated, it held 23 fill values of 1000.0, and its end nodes used half hats with full weight)
GRASP v1.1.3 spheroid mixture (Dubovik et al. 2006, fixed axis-ratio distribution; KERNELS_BASE kernels_299, ratio label 2.986)

globalAttrs.history: V5 (2026-10): metadata update of the V4 file (variable descriptions, units of qb and scama, global attributes, new sphericity and shape_description variables, lidar_ratio filled, ratio set to the exact values in the kernel headers), and the sphere entry (ratio 1) replaced by a direct Lorenz-Mie rebuild on the same grid with full end nodes (exact values; it reproduces the GRASP v1.1.3 sphere kernel to ~1e-6 at interior nodes). All non-spherical entries are identical to V4.
